text:
marco_sales: quick handoff — Aurelia Foods (mid-market retail). POC underway, onboarding checklist mostly green but a few blockers. Key asks: SAML SSO, private eval for on-prem-ish network, and a dedicated capacity estimate. Renewal flagged as medium risk (usage plateau + cost pushback).

marco_sales: TL;DR: customer saw repeated 500s on longer prompts to /v1/generate during Friday demo. They want us to triage before next exec call. They also asked for a cost estimate for reserved capacity options.

jamie_cs: thanks Marco. putting owners here. i'll own the kickoff + enablement. @oliver_cs_manager you'll own the renewal/estimate side? @maya_support pls triage the 500s. @leo_engineer can you eyeball model fallback suggestions if it's kv/cache related? :eyes:

oliver_cs_manager: yes i'll draft a reserved-capacity estimate and include 3 scenarios (baseline, x2 burst, 6mo commit). will share by Tue COB. tagging finance for numbers. :thumbsup:

maya_support: can you paste one of the failing request payloads and the request-id header? i want to reproduce locally. any pattern on sequence length / prompt size?

marco_sales: pasted the failing curl below. customer_id: aurelia-001. SSO admin: emma@aureliafoods.com. renewal: 2026-02-14. budget note: "we need to cut 20% if possible".

marco_sales: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-1","prompt":"<long product catalog + multi-turn context>...","max_tokens":1200}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
# headers: x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
```

leo_engineer: I'll take INF-1234. can you also share the raw server logs around req_0a1b2c3d? quick guesses: kv cache eviction or OOM path on long sequences. if they used a very long catalog blob it could hit compile/kernel path. i'll try repro with same model+prompt size.

oncall-bot: Incident INF-1234 created by leo_engineer for 500s on /v1/generate (severity: P2). https://issues.redwood.dev/INF-1234

maya_support: repro steps: i ran a reduced prompt in staging and got the 500 with stack snippet: "kernel_launch_failed -> CUDA out of memory". leaving a note in INF-1234.

leo_engineer: thanks Maya. can you attach the staging core dump and the exact env (gpu type, quantization config)? also try switching to `redwood-medium-1` as a quick mitigation — if that reduces mem pressure we can suggest a model variant fallback in the routing policy.

jamie_cs: next steps (short):
- CS kickoff (owner: jamie_cs) — invite emma + engineering + ops. target: Mon 10am PT.
- Support triage (owner: maya_support) — confirm root cause, attach logs to INF-1234. target: EOD today.
- Eng mitigation (owner: leo_engineer) — suggest immediate routing fallback & kv/cache config. target: 24h.
- Commercial estimate (owner: oliver_cs_manager) — reserved capacity scenarios + optional private eval pricing. target: Tue COB.

marco_sales: customer also gave feedback: latency spikes when generating long receipts; they want latency baseline numbers for 95p token latency and cost per 1M tokens. please capture in the enablement deck.

oliver_cs_manager: noted. i'll include latency baselines from the console for the three models and the cost delta by quantization profile.

maya_support: small troubleshooting note — one workaround that helped in staging was lowering `max_tokens` to 800 and enabling prefix caching. i left the exact config in INF-1234 comments.

leo_engineer: if prefix caching works that's promising. i will add a temporary routing rule: if sequence_length_estimate > 1024 route to redwood-medium-1 and allow burst to redwood-large-1 for validated sessions. will PR the rule and post link.

marco_sales: shared folder w/ contract + demo video: https://files.redwood.example/aurelia-handshake (read access for cs/support/eng).

jamie_cs: capturing customer feedback bullets for playbook: "wants predictable latency for long receipts", "sensitive to price - prefers committed discount", "needs SAML SSO before production". will add to ticketing and enablement materials.

oliver_cs_manager: i assigned JIRA CS-4892 for the onboarding playbook update + renewal play. owners: jamie_cs / oliver_cs_manager. target: next-week check-in.

marco_sales: one more: they asked if private deploy evaluation can be scheduled in Feb (narrow window). please flag if timeline conflicts with infra capacity.

maya_support: i flagged potential infra constraints. want to check region availability for private eval. adding note to INF-1234 and CS-4892.

leo_engineer: created PR for routing fallback: https://git.redwood.dev/routing/PR-672 (wip). will link tests once CI completes.

jamie_cs: ok team — i'll set the kickoff invite and include a 15-min pre-call with eng to walk the logs. tagging @emma (customer) in the invite thread. :calendar:

oliver_cs_manager: final: i'll own the renewal outreach email draft and send a warm pricing deck once the estimate is ready. check-in Tue 9am PT for owners update. :party_parrot:

marco_sales: thanks all — please update INF-1234 and CS-4892 as you progress. ping me for exec escalation if we hit blockers.

maya_support: copying key notes into INF-1234 now. will post root-cause blurb when confirmed. :white_check_mark:

leo_engineer: will post mitigation PR link + test results in INF-1234 when CI passes.

jamie_cs: closing thread for now, will reopen after kickoff scheduling. :lock:
